source.prompt: A top-down battlefield backdrop for a dark fantasy tower defense game, depicting a cursed purple wasteland at night. The ground is a vast expanse of cracked, ashen violet soil in deep shades of #160f1e and #241634, with faint glowing magenta fissures and scattered patches of dead, twisted grass. The composition is deliberately calm and uncluttered across the central playfield, because the winding enemy path and the circular tower build spots will be drawn programmatically on top of this image; therefore keep the middle area as a smooth, low-contrast, evenly lit surface with only subtle texture and no strong focal objects. Decorative detail is concentrated around the outer edges and corners: gnarled leafless trees, broken chunks of ruined masonry, small clusters of glowing purple mushrooms, and thin drifting tendrils of violet mist. A soft radial glow of #241634 blooms near the upper center and fades into the darker #160f1e toward the borders, with a gentle vignette darkening the four corners. Lighting is moody and cinematic, dominated by a cool violet ambient key light with a few warm amber #fbbf24 ember accents glinting in the cracks, suggesting a land under a lingering curse. Materials read as dry cracked earth, porous weathered stone, and soft volumetric fog. The camera is a fixed orthographic top-down view looking straight down with no perspective distortion, framed as a seamless 16:9 game background. The art style is a refined stylized 3D cartoon render with hand-painted textures, soft ambient occlusion, clean readable shapes, and a cohesive dark-purple palette accented by #c084fc. No characters, no towers, no enemies, no path lines, no grid markers, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
